cues.title: A Place Kept
cues.description: The approved main theme: intimate piano, guitar on its return, and a quiet closing phrase.

cues.title: The Warm Side of the Glass
cues.description: Barb’s piano makes room for a brief guitar memory, then returns to ordinary work.

cues.title: A Room Kept for Someone
cues.description: Dianne’s opening phrase, close and unhurried on guitar.

cues.title: The Room Without the Song
cues.description: The identical piano accompaniment and timing, with Dianne’s guitar removed.

cues.title: November Water
cues.description: Low piano across open water; distant fragments on guitar.

cues.title: Unit One
cues.description: The opening pickup repeatedly stops before its expected arrival.

cues.title: Pressure in the Boards
cues.description: Wade’s falling third in low piano, with a quiet wooden pulse.

cues.title: The Unsent Reply
cues.description: Priya’s piano phrase faces the wrong way; the rests remain exposed.

cues.title: Sanding the Canoe
cues.description: Sam’s quick rising fragment moves above a buoyant fingerpicked accompaniment.

cues.title: Chairs After Closing
cues.description: Exposed piano chords and brief answering fragments in an empty hall.

cues.title: The Road Still Goes
cues.description: Tam’s steady wooden pulse under passing guitar phrases.

cues.title: Places at the Table
cues.description: Dianne and Sam answer across Barb’s harmony, then the room thins.

cues.title: Two Different Letters
cues.description: The inverted turn becomes legible after a pause; the last E remains unsettled.

cues.title: A Person at the Bus Door
cues.description: Sam’s phrase slows down. Piano answers without claiming the whole room.

cues.title: Room for Both
cues.description: The two instruments exchange the theme; neither has to disappear.

cues.title: A Winter of Your Own
cues.description: Barb’s warm piano harmony and an unhurried opening phrase.

cues.title: A Name on the Ticket
cues.description: The guitar carries its own melody out along the road as the accompaniment falls away.

cues.title: The Place You Borrowed
cues.description: The familiar lullaby rests over piano a quarter-tone away from belonging.

cues.title: What the Book Cannot Keep
cues.description: Piano, then guitar, then the recognizable voices are gone. The ending is silence.

cues.title: Your Rising Answer
cues.description: Five shared bars followed by the player’s distinct, deliberate sixth-bar answer.

cues.title: Your Quiet Return
cues.description: Five shared bars followed by the player’s distinct, deliberate sixth-bar answer.

cues.title: Remembered Phrase: never
cues.description: The original interview’s two-note pitch and rhythm identity, on the sampled guitar.

cues.title: Remembered Phrase: forgot
cues.description: The original interview’s two-note pitch and rhythm identity, on the sampled guitar.

cues.title: Remembered Phrase: door
cues.description: The original interview’s two-note pitch and rhythm identity, on the sampled guitar.

cues.title: The Five-Bar Call
cues.description: The theme’s five-bar call in low, resonant piano; the sixth measure stays empty.

cues.title: At the Valve
cues.description: The theme’s five-bar call in low, resonant piano; the sixth measure stays empty.
